title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of LiteSport Strollers
summary: Lock mechanisms, found on both sides of the stroller, can break and cause the stroller to suddenly collapse. When the strollers collapse, babies can fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 115,000.

title: CPSC, LTD Commodities Inc. Announce Recall of Three- and Five-Wick Glass Oil Lamps
summary: If the glass sleeves are not properly secured around the wicks, or the wicks are not properly inserted, the top glass of the lamps could shatter. Units: Approximately 5,300.

title: CPSC, STK International Announce Recall of Children's Toys
summary: The toys can break, causing small balls to be released, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 110,000.

title: CPSC, World Industries Announce Recall of Skateboard Helmets
summary: These helmets failed impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls and could suffer head injuries or death. Units: 10,000.

title: CPSC, XL Machine Ltd. Announce Recall of Dollhouse Furniture Sets Sold at Target Stores
summary: The yellow paint on the furniture contains lead, which can present a risk of lead poisoning to young children. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. (REI) Announce Recall of Children's Baseball Caps
summary: The adjustment cords, located on the rear of the hats, use a snap-on plastic pull. The snap-on plastic pull could separate from the cord, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Kids "R" Us and Babies "R" Us Announce Recall of Children's Cargo Pants
summary: The toggle on the pockets of the pants can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The ball joints in the A-arm assembly on these vehicles can break, which could cause the front wheels to lose stability. title: CPSC, BikeE Announce Recall of Recumbent Bicycle Suspension Forks
summary: The link pins in the forks can fall out, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries. Units: 1,400.

title: CPSC, The Discovery Channel Store Announce Recall of Oil Lamps
summary: The glass on these lamps can shatter when lit, posing a fire and laceration hazard to consumers. Units: 16,000.

title: CPSC, Snapper Announce Recall of Walk-Behind Lawn Mowers
summary: Lawn mowers that have a serial number beginning with a 0 may exhibit improper blade retention that could injure the operator or a bystander, if the blade separates from the mower's housing. title: CPSC, SoloRider Industries Announce Recall of Single Rider Golf Carts
summary: The golf cart's software can be corrupted by static electricity, allowing it to move forward without assistance. Riders or bystanders could suffer injuries. Units: About 200.

title: CPSC, Wenzel Announce Recall of Ozark Trail and Wenzel Propane Camping Lanterns
summary: An insufficient connection between the lantern and the propane cylinder can allow gas to escape and ignite unexpectedly, posing a potential fire and injury hazard to consumers. This hazard can occur during the lighting or normal use of the lantern. Units: About 290,000.
